scenario: RTIM.8.3.1 — tests are a separate file type, not a gated capability, so no setting turns them on. A `use` block line `test: true` is a compile error, DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY, under every dialect; this case uses `default`.
rules_ds:
use default:
    test: true

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
